objective: Let the JSON-reading holyagent commands take their payload inline as `--input '<json>'`, as holycodex-agent 0.16.12 does, falling back to stdin, so the root never writes a draft file.
scope: Repository: /home/user/holyagent, branch release/0.1.2-1/fix/legacy-state-takeover. User request: the root creates Intents and Assignments through the agent-facing holyagent CLI without hand-written JSON draft files, the way holycodex-agent 0.16.12 does.

Findings to build on (accepted trace): holyagent reads JSON payloads only from stdin through the input(schema)/inputBy(pick) helpers in packages/runtime/src/cli/context.ts:59-79, bound to host.stdin in callFor (packages/runtime/src/cli/program.ts:39-55, :52-53); parseArgs is packages/runtime/src/cli/args.ts:18-49; Call.input is documented in packages/runtime/src/cli/types.ts:74-77. holycodex-agent takes `--input <json>` inline in argv, decoded with Schema.fromJsonString and onExcessProperty: "error" (holycodex packages/agent/src/index.ts:431-443).

Change: add an `--input <json>` string flag to intent create, intent update, assignment create and assignment dispatch (packages/runtime/src/cli/intent.ts:66,123; packages/runtime/src/cli/assignment.ts:150,176). When the flag is given, decode it with the same strict schema as stdin (blank or invalid JSON fails the same way, with a hint); when absent, read stdin as today.
